subtitle: null

title: Make something worth keeping.
subtitle: null
body:
Crafteris is a creative studio built around a simple idea: making things with your hands should feel accessible, rewarding and enjoyable.

Some people come for a single workshop. Some want to learn a new craft across several weeks. Others want a studio they can return to regularly and work more independently.

Crafteris brings those different ways of making together in one place.

title: Pottery and glass, under one roof.
subtitle: null
body: Crafteris gives people the chance to explore different materials without needing separate studios, equipment or experience.\n\nYou can paint pottery one week, discover fused glass the next, join a longer course or eventually become a regular studio member.
